body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-08-08 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "our own belief is that we would like to continue this 20%, 25% growth for the next 2-3 years" Metric: Revenue CAGR. Target: +20-25% p.a. FY26-FY28. Deadline: 2028-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: withdrawn. Evidence: May-26: FY27 guided at '15% plus'; when an analyst recalled the ~20% expectation, management explained the Middle East and labour constraints ('could revisit this number at the end of Q2'). Explanation given: Middle East disruption, election-period labour (May-26, prompted)
